Status::Deferred/Tier::T3 modeled via the existing VerifyCheck{harness,name,passed,detail} shape: passed:true (advisory, never flips doctor's exit code) with detail == "deferred: no mechanization yet (T3)". Flagged in proof/install/c08-stubs.json deviations for whoever lands arc-02's AdapterId/registry.

On this Windows host, `cargo test -p enforcer-install` (and running the compiled test exe directly) failed with 'The requested operation requires elevation. (os error 740)' -- a UAC installer-detection heuristic triggered by the substring 'install' in the compiled binary filename (enforcer_install-*.exe). Fixed by setting __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker before invoking cargo test; no source change needed. Same class of issue as the L29 dogfood note in the worker briefing.
